members.name: class
members.description: Additional CSS classes merged into the dialog content panel.

members.name: overlayClass
members.description: Additional CSS classes merged into the overlay for styling its backdrop.

members.name: default
members.description: The dialog panel content, usually composing a title, description, and action buttons; it is rendered through the built-in Portal.

members.name: variant
members.description: The action button’s color, border, and interaction-state style variant.

members.name: class
members.description: Additional CSS classes merged into the action button root.

members.name: asChild
members.description: Merges root props, styles, and closure behavior into the single default-slot child, which must retain accessible button interaction.

default.fallback: When omitted, the underlying Primitive uses false.

members.name: as
members.description: Selects the root tag or component; asChild uses the child from the default slot instead.

default.fallback: When omitted, Reka AlertDialogAction renders a button.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables normal user activation of a native button. A custom root element must implement its own disabled behavior.

members.name: dir
members.description: Sets the text direction of the root element, such as ltr, rtl, or auto.

members.name: type
members.description: Selects native button behavior: a regular button, form submission, or form reset.

default.fallback: When omitted and the Reka primitive uses as="button", the underlying DialogClose supplies type="button".

members.name: form
members.description: Associates the button with a form by its element ID, including a form outside its DOM ancestors.

members.name: value
members.description: The value included with name in form data when this button is the submitter. Visible button text comes from the default slot.

members.name: id
members.description: The root element’s DOM ID, used by label references, selectors, and fragment links.

members.name: onCopy
members.description: Handles copy operations with access to clipboard data through ClipboardEvent.

members.name: onCut
members.description: Handles cut operations and can customize clipboard content through ClipboardEvent.

members.name: onPaste
members.description: Handles paste operations and exposes incoming clipboard content through ClipboardEvent.

members.name: onCompositionend
members.description: Handles the end or cancellation of an IME composition session on an editable root.

members.name: onCompositionstart
members.description: Handles the start of an IME composition session on an editable root.

members.name: onCompositionupdate
members.description: Handles changes to IME composition text on an editable root.

members.name: onDrag
members.description: Handles repeated drag events on the source during native drag and drop.

members.name: onDragend
members.description: Handles the end of native dragging, including successful drops and cancellation.

members.name: onDragenter
members.description: Handles a dragged element or text entering the drop target.

members.name: onDragexit
members.description: Handles the legacy dragexit event when an element ceases to be the immediate drag target; dispatch depends on browser support.

members.name: onDragleave
members.description: Handles a dragged element or text leaving the drop target.

members.name: onDragover
members.description: Handles dragging over a drop target; accepting a drop typically requires preventDefault().

members.name: onDragstart
members.description: Handles the start of native dragging and can populate DragEvent.dataTransfer.

members.name: onDrop
members.description: Handles a drop on a valid target and exposes transferred data through dataTransfer.

members.name: onFocus
members.description: Handles the root gaining focus; native focus events do not bubble.

members.name: onFocusin
members.description: Handles bubbling focus-in events from the root or its descendants.

members.name: onFocusout
members.description: Handles bubbling focus-out events from the root or its descendants.

members.name: onBlur
members.description: Handles the root losing focus; native blur events do not bubble.

members.name: onChange
members.description: Handles committed value changes from an input or selection control; activating a regular button does not produce this event.

members.name: onBeforeinput
members.description: Handles impending user edits to editable content on a supporting root element.

members.name: onFormdata
members.description: Handles completion of form-data construction on a form root element.

members.name: onInput
members.description: Handles user-driven value changes on an editable root element.

members.name: onReset
members.description: Handles a form reset on a form root; the event is dispatched on the form.

members.name: onSubmit
members.description: Handles submission on a form root; a regular submit button causes its owning form to dispatch this event.

members.name: onInvalid
members.description: Handles failed constraint validation on a supporting root control; native invalid events do not bubble.

members.name: onFullscreenchange
members.description: Handles fullscreen-state changes when the root or a descendant enters or leaves fullscreen.

members.name: onFullscreenerror
members.description: Handles a failed fullscreen request from the root or a descendant.

members.name: onLoad
members.description: Handles completed resource loading when the root is an element that supports load events.

members.name: onError
members.description: Handles root resource failures, such as image or media errors; it is not a handler for arbitrary Vue component exceptions.

members.name: onKeydown
members.description: Handles key presses, including browser-generated repeats while a key remains held.

members.name: onKeypress
members.description: Handles the deprecated keypress character-key event; use keydown or beforeinput for new keyboard interactions.

members.name: onKeyup
members.description: Handles the release of a keyboard key.

members.name: onDblclick
members.description: Handles a completed double-click with the primary mouse button.

members.name: onMousedown
members.description: Handles a mouse button being pressed over the element.

members.name: onMouseenter
members.description: Handles the mouse entering the element’s boundary; unlike mouseover, it does not bubble.

members.name: onMouseleave
members.description: Handles the mouse leaving the element and its descendants; this event does not bubble.

members.name: onMousemove
members.description: Handles mouse movement over the element.

members.name: onMouseout
members.description: Handles bubbling mouse-out events when leaving the current hit target, including movement into a child.

members.name: onMouseover
members.description: Handles bubbling mouse-over events when entering the current hit target.

members.name: onMouseup
members.description: Handles a mouse button being released over the element.

members.name: onAbort
members.description: Handles aborted loading on a media root when the interruption is not caused by a loading error.

members.name: onCanplay
members.description: Handles a media root becoming able to start playback without assurance of uninterrupted playback to the end.

members.name: onCanplaythrough
members.description: Handles the browser estimating that a media root can play through without pausing to buffer.

members.name: onDurationchange
members.description: Handles a change to the media root’s duration information.

members.name: onEmptied
members.description: Handles a media root returning from a loaded state to an empty state, such as when reloading.

members.name: onEncrypted
members.description: Handles encrypted initialization data encountered by a media root through MediaEncryptedEvent.

members.name: onEnded
members.description: Handles a media root reaching the end of playback and stopping.

members.name: onLoadeddata
members.description: Handles the first loading of data at the media root’s current playback position, usually the first frame.

members.name: onLoadedmetadata
members.description: Handles a media root’s metadata becoming available, such as duration or video dimensions.

members.name: onLoadstart
members.description: Handles a media root beginning to load its resource.

members.name: onPause
members.description: Handles a media root entering the paused state.

members.name: onPlay
members.description: Handles a media root’s paused state becoming false when playback is requested.

members.name: onPlaying
members.description: Handles a media root actually starting or resuming playback.

members.name: onProgress
members.description: Handles data-loading progress on a root that emits resource progress events, such as a media element.

members.name: onRatechange
members.description: Handles a change to the media root’s playback rate.

members.name: onSeeked
members.description: Handles a media root completing a seek to a playback position.

members.name: onSeeking
members.description: Handles a media root beginning to seek to a new playback position.

members.name: onStalled
members.description: Handles a media root still attempting to fetch data when delivery unexpectedly stops.

members.name: onSuspend
members.description: Handles the browser intentionally suspending data fetching for a media root.

members.name: onTimeupdate
members.description: Handles updates to a media root’s currentTime.

members.name: onVolumechange
members.description: Handles changes to a media root’s volume or muted state.

members.name: onWaiting
members.description: Handles a media root waiting to continue playback because data is temporarily unavailable.

members.name: onSelect
members.description: Handles text selection in an input root that supports text selection.

members.name: onScroll
members.description: Handles changes to the scroll position of a scrollable root.

members.name: onScrollend
members.description: Handles scrolling finishing on a scrollable root once the associated scrolling gesture has ended.

members.name: onTouchcancel
members.description: Handles the browser or device interrupting a sequence of touch contacts.

members.name: onTouchend
members.description: Handles one or more touch contacts leaving the touch surface.

members.name: onTouchmove
members.description: Handles touch contacts moving across the touch surface.

members.name: onTouchstart
members.description: Handles one or more touch contacts beginning on the touch surface.

members.name: onAuxclick
members.description: Handles a completed click with a non-primary pointing-device button, such as the middle mouse button.

members.name: onClick
members.description: Handles native activation clicks, typically from a mouse, touch, or keyboard; Reka’s click handler also requests dialog closure.
notes: An asynchronous callback does not make AlertDialogAction wait for completion; use controlled open state on AlertDialogRoot when application logic must manage closure.

members.name: onContextmenu
members.description: Handles a request to open a context menu, such as a right-click or the context-menu key.

members.name: onGotpointercapture
members.description: Handles the element gaining capture of a pointer so subsequent pointer events target it.

members.name: onLostpointercapture
members.description: Handles the element losing capture of a pointer.

members.name: onPointerdown
members.description: Handles a pointer becoming active, such as touch contact or the first mouse-button press.

members.name: onPointermove
members.description: Handles changes to pointer position or properties such as pressure.

members.name: onPointerup
members.description: Handles a pointer leaving its active pressed state.

members.name: onPointercancel
members.description: Handles the browser cancelling pointer interaction, such as when taking over a touch-scrolling gesture.

members.name: onPointerenter
members.description: Handles a pointer entering the hit boundaries of the element or its descendants; it does not bubble.

members.name: onPointerleave
members.description: Handles a pointer leaving the hit boundaries of the element and its descendants; it does not bubble.

members.name: onPointerover
members.description: Handles bubbling pointer-over events when a pointer enters the current hit target.

members.name: onPointerout
members.description: Handles bubbling pointer-out events when leaving the current hit target, including movement into a child.

members.name: onBeforetoggle
members.description: Handles an impending open or close on a root supporting toggle events, such as a native popover or dialog.

members.name: onToggle
members.description: Handles a completed open or close on a supporting root, such as details, a popover, or a native dialog.

members.name: onWheel
members.description: Handles wheel-device scrolling or zooming input; it does not necessarily mean the scroll position changed.

members.name: onAnimationcancel
members.description: Handles a CSS animation being cancelled before normal completion.

members.name: onAnimationstart
members.description: Handles a CSS animation starting after its delay.

members.name: onAnimationend
members.description: Handles a CSS animation completing normally.

members.name: onAnimationiteration
members.description: Handles a CSS animation finishing an iteration and beginning another.

members.name: onSecuritypolicyviolation
members.description: Handles content-security-policy violation events reaching the root; browsers normally dispatch these on document, so a button listener does not receive every document-level violation.

members.name: onTransitioncancel
members.description: Handles a CSS transition being cancelled before completion.

members.name: onTransitionend
members.description: Handles a CSS transition completing normally.

members.name: onTransitionrun
members.description: Handles a CSS transition being created, before any transition delay.

members.name: onTransitionstart
members.description: Handles a CSS transition starting after its delay.

members.name: autofocus
members.description: Requests browser autofocus. Reka still performs its focus management when the dialog opens.

members.name: formaction
members.description: The destination URL used when this button submits its form, overriding the form action.

members.name: formenctype
members.description: The data encoding used when this button submits its form, overriding the form enctype.

members.name: formmethod
members.description: The submission method used by this button, overriding the form method.

members.name: formnovalidate
members.description: Skips browser constraint validation when this button submits its form.

members.name: formtarget
members.description: Selects the browsing context that displays this button’s form response, overriding the form target.

members.name: name
members.description: The field name included in form data with value when this button is the submitter.

members.name: innerHTML
members.description: Writes an HTML string into the root element, replacing the children rendered by its default slot.

members.name: accesskey
members.description: Provides an access-key hint for the root element; the browser and operating system determine the key combination.

members.name: contenteditable
members.description: Controls whether root content is editable; plaintext-only allows plain-text editing, while inherit inherits the editing state.

members.name: contextmenu
members.description: A legacy HTML context-menu association containing a menu element ID; it does not create or open a BrutxUI menu.

members.name: draggable
members.description: Controls whether the root element can be a source for native browser drag and drop.

members.name: enterkeyhint
members.description: Suggests the virtual keyboard’s Enter-key label or icon for an editable root element.

members.name: enterKeyHint
members.description: Vue’s deprecated camel-case alias for the virtual keyboard Enter-key hint; use enterkeyhint.

members.name: hidden
members.description: Controls the root element’s HTML hidden state; until-found allows supporting browsers to reveal it through features such as find-in-page.

members.name: inert
members.description: Makes the root and its flat-tree descendants inert, preventing focus and normal user interaction.

members.name: lang
members.description: Identifies the language of the root content for screen-reader pronunciation and browser text processing.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: Passes an input placeholder to a supporting input root; a regular button does not display placeholder text.

members.name: spellcheck
members.description: Controls the browser’s spell-checking hint for editable content.

members.name: tabindex
members.description: Sets root focus order: 0 uses document order, while -1 allows programmatic focus outside sequential keyboard navigation.

members.name: title
members.description: Provides supplementary text through the browser’s native title behavior.

members.name: translate
members.description: Indicates whether translation tools should translate the root element’s translatable text and attributes.

members.name: radiogroup
members.description: The group name for legacy HTML radio commands; it does not give the action button radio-group behavior.

members.name: role
members.description: Sets the root’s role for assistive technology; it must match the rendered element and its interaction behavior.

members.name: about
members.description: Identifies the subject resource described by RDFa metadata.

members.name: datatype
members.description: Specifies the datatype of an RDFa literal value.

members.name: inlist
members.description: Adds the RDFa relationship object to its predicate’s list; presence matters and the attribute value is ignored.

members.name: prefix
members.description: Declares RDFa prefix-to-IRI mappings for abbreviated metadata identifiers.

members.name: property
members.description: Declares RDFa properties relating a subject to a resource or literal.

members.name: resource
members.description: Supplies a resource identifier used in an RDFa relationship.

members.name: typeof
members.description: Declares the types of the resource described by RDFa.

members.name: vocab
members.description: Sets the default vocabulary IRI used for RDFa terms.

members.name: autocapitalize
members.description: Suggests automatic capitalization for editable content, such as sentences, words, or all characters.

members.name: autocorrect
members.description: Provides an autocorrection hint for an editable root that supports it.

members.name: autosave
members.description: A Safari search-input extension naming stored search history; a regular button does not save searches.

members.name: color
members.description: Passes the legacy HTML color presentation attribute; the action button’s colors are controlled by variant and CSS classes.

members.name: itemprop
members.description: Names the properties supplied by the root element in HTML microdata.

members.name: itemscope
members.description: Creates an HTML microdata item scope on the root element.

members.name: itemtype
members.description: Specifies vocabulary type URLs for the microdata item created by itemscope.

members.name: itemid
members.description: Provides a global identifier for a microdata item, together with itemscope and itemtype.

members.name: itemref
members.description: Lists space-separated IDs of elements outside the scope that contribute microdata properties.

members.name: results
members.description: A Safari search-input extension limiting search-history menu entries; a regular button has no such menu.

members.name: security
members.description: A legacy Internet Explorer iframe security-zone attribute; the action button does not use it to implement a security policy.

members.name: unselectable
members.description: A legacy selection attribute: on prevents starting text selection on the element, while off allows it.

members.name: inputmode
members.description: Suggests a virtual keyboard layout for an editable root, such as numeric or email; it does not validate input.

members.name: is
members.description: Names a registered customized built-in element for the HTML root; support depends on the browser and rendering path.

members.name: exportparts
members.description: Maps and exposes names of internal shadow parts to outer ::part selectors.

members.name: part
members.description: Names the root element’s shadow parts for external styling through ::part.

members.name: aria-activedescendant
members.description: References the active item in a composite widget while DOM focus stays on the widget root.

members.name: aria-atomic
members.description: Indicates whether a live-region change is announced as the whole region or only its changed parts.

members.name: aria-autocomplete
members.description: Describes text-input completion as inline, list-based, both, or absent.

members.name: aria-busy
members.description: Marks a region as updating so assistive technology can defer presenting its changes.

members.name: aria-checked
members.description: Describes the checked state of checkable controls; mixed represents partial selection for roles that support it.

members.name: aria-colcount
members.description: Provides the total column count of a table, grid, or treegrid, including columns absent from the DOM.

members.name: aria-colindex
members.description: Provides an element’s one-based column position in a table or grid.

members.name: aria-colspan
members.description: Provides the number of columns spanned by a table or grid cell.

members.name: aria-controls
members.description: Lists space-separated IDs of elements whose content or presence this control manages.

members.name: aria-current
members.description: Identifies the current item in a related set, optionally as a page, step, location, date, or time.

members.name: aria-describedby
members.description: Lists space-separated IDs of elements that provide a supplementary description for the root.

members.name: aria-details
members.description: References an element containing structured details that users can explore further.

members.name: aria-disabled
members.description: Communicates that the control is unavailable; this attribute alone does not prevent clicks or dialog closure.

members.name: aria-dropeffect
members.description: Deprecated drag-and-drop semantics describing operations available when an object is dropped on the target.

members.name: aria-errormessage
members.description: References the current error-message element, together with aria-invalid to express an invalid state.

members.name: aria-expanded
members.description: Describes whether the control or its controlled content is expanded; application logic manages expansion.

members.name: aria-flowto
members.description: References subsequent elements in an alternative reading order that assistive technology can offer to users.

members.name: aria-grabbed
members.description: A deprecated drag-and-drop state indicating whether the element is grabbed for dragging.

members.name: aria-haspopup
members.description: Declares the kind of interactive popup the control can open, such as menu or dialog; it does not create a popup.

members.name: aria-hidden
members.description: Controls whether the element and descendants are hidden from the accessibility tree, without changing visual display or keyboard focus.

members.name: aria-invalid
members.description: Describes invalid input, including grammar or spelling errors.

members.name: aria-keyshortcuts
members.description: Advertises keyboard shortcuts already implemented by the application; it does not register key handlers.

members.name: aria-label
members.description: Provides the root’s accessible name directly, such as the action name of an icon-only confirmation button.

members.name: aria-labelledby
members.description: Lists space-separated IDs of elements that supply the root’s accessible name.

members.name: aria-level
members.description: Provides the one-based level of a hierarchical item, such as a heading or tree item.

members.name: aria-live
members.description: Sets live-region announcement priority: off, polite, or assertive.

members.name: aria-modal
members.description: Declares a supported dialog role as modal; dialog primitives implement the actual focus containment.

members.name: aria-multiline
members.description: Describes whether a textbox accepts multiple lines of input.

members.name: aria-multiselectable
members.description: Describes whether a selectable collection allows multiple selected items.

members.name: aria-orientation
members.description: Describes whether a widget uses horizontal or vertical orientation.

members.name: aria-owns
members.description: Uses element IDs to establish accessibility ownership not expressed by the DOM hierarchy.

members.name: aria-placeholder
members.description: Provides an expected-value or format hint for an empty input control; it does not replace the control’s name.

members.name: aria-posinset
members.description: Describes a list or tree item’s one-based position in its set.

members.name: aria-pressed
members.description: Describes a toggle button’s pressed state; mixed indicates a mixed state, and application logic manages changes.

members.name: aria-readonly
members.description: Declares that a supporting widget remains operable while its value cannot be edited.

members.name: aria-relevant

type.text: "text" | "additions" | "additions removals" | "additions text" | "all" | "removals" | "removals additions" | "removals text" | "text additions" | "text removals" | undefined

members.description: Selects which live-region changes warrant announcements, including additions, removals, and text changes.

members.name: aria-required
members.description: Declares that an input control requires a value; native constraints or application logic perform validation.

members.name: aria-roledescription
members.description: Provides a localized, user-facing description of the element’s existing role.

members.name: aria-rowcount
members.description: Provides the total row count of a table, grid, or treegrid, including rows absent from the DOM.

members.name: aria-rowindex
members.description: Provides an element’s one-based row position in a table or grid.

members.name: aria-rowspan
members.description: Provides the number of rows spanned by a table or grid cell.

members.name: aria-selected
members.description: Describes selection for supporting roles such as options, tabs, and grid rows.

members.name: aria-setsize
members.description: Provides the total item count in the set containing a list or tree item.

members.name: aria-sort
members.description: Describes the sort direction of data associated with a table or grid header.

members.name: aria-valuemax
members.description: Provides the maximum permitted value of a range widget.

members.name: aria-valuemin
members.description: Provides the minimum permitted value of a range widget.

members.name: aria-valuenow
members.description: Provides the current numeric value of a range widget.

members.name: aria-valuetext
members.description: Expresses a range widget’s current value as meaningful text, such as a named level.

members.name: default
members.description: The action button’s text or icon; with asChild, provide a single child that receives the props and interaction behavior.

members.name: class
members.description: Additional CSS classes merged into the cancel button root, which uses the outline variant.

members.name: default
members.description: The cancel button content; activation requests closure, and Reka attempts to focus this button when the dialog opens.

members.name: class
members.description: Additional CSS classes merged into the dialog description element.

members.name: default
members.description: Content explaining the operation and its consequences, associated by Reka with the dialog’s accessible description.

members.name: class
members.description: Additional CSS classes merged into the footer container for action buttons.

members.name: default
members.description: Footer actions, usually cancel and confirmation buttons; the footer container is omitted when this slot is not provided.

members.name: class
members.description: Additional CSS classes merged into the header container for the title and description.

members.name: default
members.description: Header content, usually combining AlertDialogTitle and AlertDialogDescription.

members.name: class
members.description: Additional CSS classes merged into the dialog title element.

members.name: default
members.description: The dialog title, associated by Reka with its accessible name; supply a title describing the operation to confirm.
notes: Without renderable slot content, the fallback is the English text Alert; this fallback is not localized.
